# Design

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-design-doc.mjs. Run `npm run design-doc` after editing app/globals.css. Do not hand-edit this file. -->

How this site is styled, and the rules for adding to it. There are no swatches here on purpose: [`/design-system`](app/design-system/page.tsx) renders the real tokens live and is the visual truth. This file is the written half.

Tokens live in one place, the `:root` block of [`app/globals.css`](app/globals.css). There is no theme layer and no Tailwind config in play; Tailwind is installed but unused.

## Core (shared with the photography site)

One brand decision across both repos. Changing a value here changes two sites, so treat it as a brand change rather than a CSS tweak.

| Token | Value | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `--accent` | `#941818` | Crimson. Links, eyebrows, hovers, the FM mark. One brand decision across both sites. |
| `--bg` | `#0a0a0a` | Page background. Every full-bleed surface sits on this. |
| `--surface` | `#111111` | Raised panels: portfolio grid, contact section, component cards. |
| `--ease-spring` | `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` | Slides, expands, drawers: dropdown, hamburger morph, card arrow. |
| `--ease-cover` | `cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)` | Hover zoom on images. Photo thumbnails only, so far. |
| `--font-ui` | `"Alte Haas Grotesk", "Arial Narrow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` | Everything on the site. The fallback stack is longer here than on the photography site, which the checker reports as informational, not drift. |
| `--font-serif` | `"Iowan Old Style", "Georgia", serif` | Carried for brand parity. Nothing in this repo references it yet. |

The photography site's own table is not duplicated here. To confirm the two repos still agree, run:

```bash
node "../FM Photography Site/scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs"
```

Exit 0 is in sync, exit 1 prints the drifted values. Font tokens compare the first family only, since fallback stacks legitimately differ between the repos. The list above is read from that checker at generation time (source: check-design-tokens.mjs), so the two definitions of "core" cannot drift apart.

## This site only

Not shared, not checked, free to diverge from the photography repo.

| Token | Value | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `--text` | `#fff` | Neutral white. Body copy, headings, nav links. |
| `--muted` | `#666` | Secondary copy: dates, labels, breadcrumbs, footer. |
| `--rule` | `#1b1b1b` | Every 1px divider and border. Roughly 7% white, deliberately faint. |
| `--nav-h` | `64px` | Fixed nav height. The mobile menu insets from it, so they stay locked together. |

### Component classes

Plain global classes in `app/globals.css`, no CSS modules. Grouped by prefix.

| Family | Classes | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| `card-*` | 12 | Portfolio grid cards. |
| `contact-*` | 7 | Contact section, links, and the form shell. |
| `detail-*` | 19 | Full-screen portfolio detail overlays and the image rail. |
| `ds-*` | 28 | The live /design-system page. |
| `footer-*` | 3 | Site footer. |
| `form-*` | 2 | Form fields and the submit button. Reused as the primary button on /design-system. |
| `hero-*` | 8 | Homepage parallax hero. |
| `nav-*` | 2 | Fixed top nav and its links. |
| `photo-*` | 4 | Photography teaser grid. Mask plus scaled layer, so a real <img> drops in without restructuring. |
| `portfolio-*` | 4 | Portfolio grid section and its header. |
| `profile-*` | 4 | Homepage About block, plus .profile-cta as the standard text link. |
| `resume-*` | 9 | The /resume page: timeline entries, contact row, skill tags. |
| `section-*` | 3 | Shared section primitives: eyebrow, heading, body. Use these before writing new type styles. |

Plus 9 standalone state and modifier classes, toggled from TSX rather than written into markup: `.dropdown`, `.hamburger`, `.has-dropdown`, `.mobile-menu`, `.next`, `.open`, `.prev`, `.scroll-line`, `.scrolled`.

## Rules

- Style new work with the tokens and classes already here before adding CSS. `section-eyebrow`, `section-heading`, `section-body`, `profile-cta` and `form-submit` cover most of what a new page needs.
- Never fall back to a bare `ease` or an uncurved transition. Use `--ease-spring` for anything that slides or expands and `--ease-cover` for image zoom. The site used bare `ease` before the token re-sync and it read flatter than the rest of the work.
- After changing any core token, run the drift check below. Core is a shared brand decision, so a change here is a change to two sites.
- The font `@import` stays the first line of `globals.css`, with the explicit 400 and 700 `@font-face` rules directly after it. The cdnfonts stylesheet lists `local('Alte Haas Grotesk')` first for both weights, which resolves to the installed Regular on a Mac and renders every bold heading at regular weight. The cross-repo check fails a repo that relies on `local()`. Verify a weight change by measuring rendered text width at 400 against 700, never by eye.
- Site-only tokens and component classes are free to diverge from the photography repo. They are not expected to match and the checker ignores them.
- The distressed title filter is a single SVG `<defs>` block in `app/layout.tsx` (`#distressed-folio`), shared across routes. Reference it with `filter: url(#distressed-folio)`, never a second copy.
- `/design-system` is the visual truth for color, type, motion and components. This file holds the rules; the page holds the swatches. Do not restate swatch values here.
